findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] The unauthenticated surface is now explicitly enumerated rather than emergent, which is the allow-list ctx.text asks for. Routers are partitioned into three named groups - PUBLIC_ROUTERS (healthcheck alone), AUTHENTICATED_ROUTERS (orders, admin, users, referrals), and MIXED_ROUTERS (auth, menu, each justified in-file) - and the authenticated group is mounted with router-level dependencies=[Depends(get_current_user)], so a route added there is refused to anonymous callers even if it declares nothing itself. Authentication is the default, and tests/security/test_router_grouping.py fails the build for any router mounted without appearing in one of the lists. This closes the prior state in which /debug and /delivery/orders were anonymously reachable. The remaining suggestions in ctx.text - lighter-weight technologies and relocating the public surface to a separate server - are deployment-topology choices outside this file | verdict=pass confidence=high
